title: Email partial deserialization claim in doc is false
description: Email::doc says 'all optional fields are represented as Option so a partial response can still deserialize'. This is false for the required metadata fields (blob_id, thread_id, mailbox_ids, size, received_at). An Email/get response with properties:[from,subject] omits these fields; serde_json::from_str::<Email> returns 'missing field blob_id'. The claim in the doc is misleading and will generate user issues when anyone tries partial Email/get. Fix: either (a) correct the doc to say this type requires all metadata properties to be present, or (b) make the metadata fields Option (API-breaking but more correct). Preferred: fix the doc + add a dedicated section explaining the limitation.
